title: Commander Okafor
notes: The denial: log five, now interactive. The Section 31 officer. The player
may press or let it go, and neither answer changes what is true.

lines.text: INCOMING -- U.S.S. ADIRONDACK -- UNLOGGED
Commander Okafor. You don't know me. Shepard does.
She tells me you have questions about my employer.
INCOMING -- U.S.S. ADIRONDACK -- UNLOGGED
Okafor. I called once already. I don't usually.
Asleep, for once. This is not her conversation.
Then I'll answer the one you didn't ask.
It wasn't us. It wasn't anyone I know of.
We did not disable this ship. We did not do that
to the county below you. We were as blind as she was.
It is. If it were us, I would not be calling you.
I'd be letting you believe it. It's cheaper.
I can't. There is nothing I could show you that
an organisation like mine could not also forge.
That is the problem with us. We earned it.

options.text: Then why should anyone trust you?
All right. I'll let it go.

lines.text: They shouldn't. Believe the evidence, not me.
The Doctor's reading half a signature. Follow that.
Don't, particularly. Believe what the Doctor finds.
Because she will not hear it from me any more.
And because whoever did this is still out there.
Five months she's been angry at the wrong people.
Somebody left the room before we were blinded,
and came back for the test. I want to know who.
Okafor out.
